conflicts.claim_as_written: Jun confirmed the Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-07-10, comfortably after the workshop, so we'll host the Coffee & Cashew dataset on legacy Corpus for June and migrate in the first week of July.
conflicts.note: This side of the drift group states the canonical corpus_v2_freeze date (2026-07-10) correctly; counterpart projects misstate it.
